description: A painted palace hall with gilded arched windows, candelabras and a dark gilt canopy. Kneeling men in brocade robes and tall golden conical crowns hold a golden casket toward a seated, richly robed figure on a throne at the far right. Onlookers in periwigs and dark European dress stand around the room, and a red-robed figure kneels with hands pressed together at the lower right. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text.
